tools.name: get_webkul_site_index
tools.description: Get the curated index of Webkul products, platform catalogs, services and support channels (llms.txt). Use first when you need an overview of what Webkul offers.

tools.name: search_webkul_content
tools.description: Search webkul.com for products, extensions, documentation, user guides and service pages. Returns matching page titles and URLs. Use for any query about Webkul modules (Magento, Shopify, Odoo, WooCommerce, PrestaShop, OpenCart, Salesforce), their docs or services.
